newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila seeks young tourists, to promote dive spots.
newsitem.headline: Manila seeks young tourists, to promote dive spots.

text.p: The Philippines is portraying itself as a destination for young tourists this year as it actively promotes its diving and sports facilities, the Department of Tourism (DOT) said on Friday.

Tourism secretary Mina Gabor, in a report to President Fidel Ramos, said her department is concentrating on a new marketing strategy which will entice young people from North America, especially those Filipinos who were born or have migrated abroad, to visit the country.
"Aside from tapping the youth, the DOT will actively promote the Philippines as a dive- and other sports market," she added.
Tourists from North America comprise the bulk of tourists who came to the Philippines last year.
Tourist arrivals grew by 12 percent last year to 2.053 million from 1.760 million registered the previous year. Other tourists were mainly Japanese and Taiwanese.
The tourism department is hoping for 2.2 million tourists this year.
